organization: Bangladesh Police — district police units of Chattogram Range
attribution: District and thana police portals (police.<district>.gov.bd, police.<upazila>.<district>.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. SP offices from the Superintendent's officer card; thanas from each upazila's thana portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Chattogram Range (Range DIG's office, dig.chittagongdiv.gov.bd) covers the 11 districts of the division; Chattogram District is in CHATTOGRAM_POLICE_2026 and Chattogram city's CMP thanas in CHATTOGRAM_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026. Thanas that are not upazilas have no portal here. Unavailable this run: Cox's Bazar: portal police.eidgaon.coxsbazar.gov.bd did not respond
